notes: Spellbreak (Proletariat) Erode_DisortTexture01_FxM: 6 instances, all BLEND_Translucent/MSM_Unlit/one-sided; 30 emitters (sprites: Villainous dark-magic Core Dark/Core Hot/Bits, AegisWarden Core Hot, MysticOrbs + UnderworldTitan spirit cores, ShrineB_Earth Earthpulse; meshes: capture-zone Cylinder Lines). SOURCE: MaskTexture (Coordinates connected), DistortionNormalMap (TextureObject), MaskScaleU/V, MaskBrightness, MaskContrast (root default 0, not serialised), MaskEdgeSoftness, NormalMapScaleU/V, NormalMapPanU/V, FPS, PixelDepthFade, CameraFadeOffset/Length (cm -> m), switches HasCameraDepthFade/HasDepthFade, DynamicParameter [Opacity, Distortion Strength, Param3, Param4] (every emitter uses slot 0 Opacity, slot 1 Distortion Strength 0.025-0.1), functions Luos_Mask_Distorter_FPS ('Distorts/Refracts the Texture'; body keeps TextureSample + Add + FPS), CheapContrast, MF_TransluscentToonErosion ('Erodes alpha mask instead of fade out.'), MF_DepthFadeAndCameraDepthFade. TEXTURES (viewed): grey masks (LumpyGlow01/02 blobs, EarthShake1 crescents, ControlRing_Lines01 streaks), BC5 normal maps (T-f_Puddle_N, tilingcrystal). AUTHORED: normal-map UV offset (rg*2-1)*dyn1 added to TexCoord0*MaskScale, normal sampled at TexCoord0*NormalMapScale + Pan*floor(t*FPS)/FPS; mask*MaskBrightness -> CheapContrast -> smoothstep(1-a, 1-a+MaskEdgeSoftness) toon erosion (alpha clamped); opacity *= dyn0 Opacity and the switch-gated fades; emissive = particle colour * mask. vs generic shader: it skipped the distortion entirely (no scalar 'Distortion Strength'), used a fixed 0.1 edge instead of MaskEdgeSoftness, unstepped pan and ungated fades. KNOWN LIMIT: LumpyGlow01_FxT is SRGB=false (TC_Masks) but the family decodes all masks as sRGB (per-texture flag unavailable to families). LinearGradient (MaterialFunctionInfos only, no call shell) and RefractionDepthBias not reproduced. Capture-ring lines use CameraFadeOffset 15 m + Length 5 m with HasCameraDepthFade on, so they are invisible closer than 15 m (correct UE behaviour, also why the lab camera shows nothing).
